velocity_grid.rule: Use exact stored linspace grid,no fitted sub-grid minimum or adaptive range expansion.

direction: For every chronological earlier/later pair,swap the roles:later is reference,earlier is target. Include both merged and every covering individual order,all modes,flat/nonflat and all three masks. Do not select only discrepant fits.
model: For each earlier-reference/later-target pair,query reference at target_WAVE / sqrt((1+v/c)/(1-v/c));piecewise-linear interpolation of the stored reference is a temporary MODEL operation. Fit target=a*shifted_reference+b0+b1*(target_WAVE-fixed_center)/5 by unweighted least squares on each fixed side mask. Normalize each profile by its positive own D071primary baseline scalar;free a absorbs this scaling. No clipping or learned exclusions.
score: Unweighted residual sum of squares is a descriptive matching objective,not chi-square,noise likelihood,FAP,confidence interval or an uncertainty. Grid spacing is not velocity precision.
support: Require both profiles finite,positive baseline normalization,>=30mask samples and reference coverage for every grid shift. Retain all slots. Record full SSE/coeff curves,best grid index,positive-scale status and boundary hits. No alternate mask/mode/window selected based on success.
mask_rule: Apply unchanged1<=abs(target_WAVE-fixed_center)<=4Angstrom BLUE/RED/BOTH rule in the new earlier target. Within that target epoch,order and merged fits must use exactly the same common_SDP_indices and wavelengths. Forward and reverse target grids belong to different epochs:the experiment changes reference interpolation,residual assignment,and possibly sample membership. It does not isolate interpolation alone.
normalization: Own positive D071primary baseline scalar only;free fit amplitude,offset and slope. No clipping or covariance/error weighting.
reciprocal_rule: For each matched forward/reverse fit record c*(atanh(v_forward/c)+atanh(v_reverse/c)) in km/s-like log-shift units. This should vanish for an exactly reciprocal model,without claiming a noise-calibrated tolerance. The 0.05km/s grid step is not precision. Retain all1440pairs and all curves.
